G3004.def:
**λέγω**,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, [[Gen.22.16|Gen.22:16]], al. ;]
1. in Hom., **to pick out, gather, reckon, recount**.
2. In Hdt. and Att., **to say, speak, affirm, declare**: absol., [[Act.13.15; 24.10|Act.13:15, 24:10]]; before orat. dir., [[Mat.9.34|Mat.9:34]], [[Mrk.3.11|Mrk.3:11]], [[Jhn.1.29|Jhn.1:29]], al.; before ὅτι recit., [[Mrk.3.21|Mrk.3:21]], [[Luk.1.24|Luk.1:24]], [[Jhn.6.14|Jhn.6:14]], al.; accusative and inf., [[Luk.11.18|Luk.11:18]], [[Jhn.12.29|Jhn.12:29]], al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, [[Mat.11.17|Mat.11:17]], al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, _Words_, 24 ff.), [[Mat.25.9|Mat.25:9]], [[Mrk.3.33; 7.28|Mrk.3:33, 7:28]], [[Luk.24.6|Luk.24:6]], 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], [[Luk.3.8|Luk.3:8]], al.; of writing, [[2Co.8.8|2Co.8:8]], [[Php.4.11|Php.4:11]], al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή, [[Rom.4.3|Rom.4:3]], [[Jas.2.23|Jas.2:23]], al.; with accusative of thing(s), [[Luk.8.8; 9.33|Luk.8:8, 9:33]], [[Jhn.5.34|Jhn.5:34]], al.; σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, _Mk._, 359, 369f.), [[Mat.27.11|Mat.27:11]], [[Mrk.15.2|Mrk.15:2]], [[Luk.23.3|Luk.23:3]], [[Jhn.18.37|Jhn.18:37]]; with dative of person(s), before orat. dir., [[Mat.8.20|Mat.8:20]], [[Mrk.2.17|Mrk.2:17]], al. mult.; id. before ὅτι, [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], al.; with prep., πρός, μετά, περί, etc., [[Mrk.4.41|Mrk.4:41]], [[Jhn.11.56|Jhn.11:56]], [[Heb.9.5|Heb.9:5]], al.; **to mean** (cl.), [[Mrk.14.71|Mrk.14:71]], [[Jhn.6.71|Jhn.6:71]], [[1Co.10.29|1Co.10:29]], al.; **to call, name**, [[Mrk.10.18|Mrk.10:18]] pass., [[Mat.9.9|Mat.9:9]], [[Mrk.15.7|Mrk.15:7]], al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω).
_SYN._: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr., _Syn._, Ixxvi; Thayer, see word λαλέω). (AS)

G3097.def:
**μάγος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for אַשָּׁף, Dan LXX TH [[Dan.2.2, 10|Dan.2:2, 10]], al. (cf. chief magian, [[Jer.39.3, 13|Jer.39:3, 13]]) ;]
1. one of the Μάγοι, a Median tribe (Hat).
2. **a Magian, one of a sacred caste, originally Median, who seem to have conformed to the Persian religion, while retaining some of their old beliefs **(see _DB_, I vol., 565 f.; _DB_, iii, 203 ff.): [[Mat.2.1, 7; 2.16|Mat.2:1, 7 2:16]]
3. **a wizard, sorcerer**: [[Act.13.6|Act.13:6]], 8 (cf. [[Wis.17.7|Wis.17:7]], [[Act.8.9|Act.8:9]] ?[[Act.8.1|Act.8:1]]).†
(AS)

G3030.def:
**λίβανος**, -ου, ὁ
(rarely ἡ), (from the Semitic; cf. the _Heb._ equiv.), [in LXX for לְבוֹנָה [[Exo.30.34|Exo.30:34]], [[Isa.60.6|Isa.60:6]] [[Sir.24.15|Sir.24:15]], al. ;]
1. in cl., the frankincense-tree.
2. (Occas. in cl.) frankincense (so [[Lev.2.1|Lev.2:1]] cf. λιβανωτός): [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]], [[Rev.18.13|Rev.18:13]].†
(AS)

G3037.def:
**λίθος**, -ου, ὁ
(and, in Att.., of precious stones, ἡ.) [in LXX for אֶבֶן, [[Gen.11.3|Gen.11:3]], al.; λ. τίμιος, for פָּז, [[Psa.19.10; 21.3|Psa.19:10 21:3]], [[Pro.8.19|Pro.8:19]], al. ;]
**a stone**: [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]], al.; pl., [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], al.; at the entrance of a tomb, [[Mat.27.60, 66; 28.2|Mat.27:60, 66 28:2]], [[Mrk.15.46; 16.3-4|Mrk.15:46 16:3-4]], [[Luk.24.2|Luk.24:2]], [[Jhn.11.38, 32; 11.41; 20.1|Jhn.11:38, 32 11:41 20:1]]; λ. μυλικός, [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]], cf. [[Rev.18.21|Rev.18:21]] of building stones, [[Mat.21.42|Mat.21:42]], [44], [[Mat.24.2|Mat.24:2]], [[Mrk.12.10; 13.1-2|Mrk.12:10 13:1-2]], [[Luk.19.44; 20.17-18; 21.5-6|Luk.19:44 20:17-18 21:5-6]] [[Act.4.11|Act.4:11]], [[1Pe.2.7|1Pe.2:7]]; metaphorically, of Christ, λ. ἀκρογωναῖος, ἐκλεκτός, ἔντιμος, [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]] (LXX); λ. ζῶν, [[1Pe.2.4|1Pe.2:4]] προσκόμματος, [[1Pe.2.8|1Pe.2:8]], [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]]; of Christians, λ. ζῶντες, [[1Pe.2.5|1Pe.2:5]] of precious stones, λ. τίμιος, [[Rev.17.4; 18.12, 16; 21.11, 19|Rev.17:4 18:12, 16 21:11, 19]]; ἴασπις, [[Rev.4.3|Rev.4:3]] ἐνδεδυμένοι λ. καθαρόν, [[Rev.15.6|Rev.15:6]] (λίνον, Rec., R, mg., see Swete, in l); metaphorically, λ. τίμιοι, [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]] of the tables of the law, [[2Co.3.7|2Co.3:7]] of idols, [[Act.17.29|Act.17:29]]
(AS)

G3000.def:
**λατρεύω**
(λάτρις, a hired servant), [in LXX (always, as λατρεία, of the service of God or of heathen divinities) chiefly for עָבַד, [[Exo.3.12|Exo.3:12]], al.; in Dan LXX TH ([[Dan.3.12|Dan.3:12]], al.) for פְּלַח ;]
1. to work for hire.
2. **to serve**; in cl., also of divine service, to serve, worship, and so always in NT: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, [[Mat.4.10|Mat.4:10]], [[Luk.4.8|Luk.4:8]]" (LXX), [[Act.7.7; 24.14; 27.23|Act.7:7 24:14 27:23]], [[Heb.9.14|Heb.9:14]], [[Rev.7.15; 22.3|Rev.7:15 22:3]]; of idol worship (cf. [[Exo.20.5|Exo.20:5]], [[Ezk.20.32|Eze.20:32]]), [[Act.7.42|Act.7:42]], [[Rom.1.25|Rom.1:25]]; τ. θεῷ. ἐν τ. πνεύματί μου, [[Rom.1.9|Rom.1:9]] id. ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, [[2Ti.1.3|2Ti.1:3]] μετ᾽ εὐλαβείας κ. δέους, [[Heb.12.28|Heb.12:28]] ἐν ὁσιότητι κ. δικαιοσύνῃ, [[Luk.1.74|Luk.1:74]] (without θεῷ) νηστείαις κ. δεήσεσι, [[Luk.2.37|Luk.2:37]] πνεύματι θεοῦ, [[Php.3.3|Php.3:3]] absol., [[Act.26.7|Act.26:7]] ὁ λατρεύων, the worshipper, [[Heb.9.9; 10.2|Heb.9:9 10:2]]; of ministerial service, with dative of thing(s), [[Heb.8.5; 13.10|Heb.8:5 13:10]].†
_SYN._: λειτουργέω, q.v (AS)

G3088.def:
**λύχνος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for נִיר ([[Exo.25.37|Exo.25:37]]), al.) ;]
**a lamp **(portable, and usually set on a stand, λυχνία): [[Mat.5.15|Mat.5:15]], [[Luk.11.36|Luk.11:36]]; ἔρχεται ὁ λ., [[Mrk.4.21|Mrk.4:21]] λ. ἅπτειν [[Luk.8.16; 11.33; 15.8|Luk.8:16 11:33 15:8]]; φῶς λύχνου, [[Rev.18.23|Rev.18:23]] id. opposite to φ.ἡλίου, [[Rev.22.5|Rev.22:5]] metaphorically, of the eye, [[Mat.6.22|Mat.6:22]] [[Luk.11.34|Luk.11:34]]; of John the Baptist, [[Jhn.5.35|Jhn.5:35]] of the Lamb, [[Rev.21.23|Rev.21:23]] of prophecy, [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]] of spiritual readiness, pl., λύχνοι (as always in LXX; frequently in Att.. λύχνα), [[Luk.12.35|Luk.12:35]]†
_SYN._: λαμπάς, q.v (AS)

G3087.def:
**λυχνία**, -ας, ἡ
(vulgar form of λυχνίον = λυχνοῦχος; see Kennedy, _Sources_, 40), [in LXX for מְנוֹרָה ([[Exo.25.31; 40.4|Exo.25:31 40:4]], al.) ;]
**a lampstand**: [[Mat.5.15|Mat.5:15]], [[Mrk.4.21|Mrk.4:21]], [[Luk.8.16; 11.33|Luk.8:16 11:33]]; of that in the Tabernacle, [[Heb.9.2|Heb.9:2]] metaphorically, of the two witnesses, [[Rev.11.4|Rev.11:4]] of the seven churches of Asia, [[Rev.1.12-13, 20; 2.1|Rev.1:12-13, 20 2:1]]; of the removal of a church from its position, κινεῖν τ. λυχνίαν κ.τ.λ., [[Rev.2.5|Rev.2:5]]†
(AS)

G3089.def:
**λύω **
[in LXX for פָּתַח, נָתַר hi., etc. ;]
1. **to loose, unbind, release**: of things, [[Mrk.1.7|Mrk.1:7]], [[Luk.3.16|Luk.3:16]], al.; of beasts, [[Mat.21.2|Mat.21:2]], [[Luk.13.15|Luk.13:15]], al.; of persons, [[Jhn.11.44|Jhn.11:44]], [[Act.22.30|Act.22:30]]; of Satan, [[Rev.20.3|Rev.20:3]], 7; metaphorically, of the marriage tie, [[1Co.7.27|1Co.7:27]] of one diseased, [[Luk.13.16|Luk.13:16]] of release from sin, [[Rev.1.5|Rev.1:5]], WH, R, txt. (see: λούω).
2. **To resolve a whole into its parts, loosen, dissolve, break up, destroy**: [[Jhn.2.19|Jhn.2:19]], [[Act.27.41|Act.27:41]], [[Rev.5.2|Rev.5:2]]; metaphorically, [[2Pe.3.11|2Pe.3:11]] of an assembly, **to dismiss**: [[Act.13.43|Act.13:43]] τ. μεσότοιχον τ. φραγμοῦ, [[Eph.2.14|Eph.2:14]] τ. στοιχεῖα, [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]] οὐρανοί, [[2Pe.3.12|2Pe.3:12]] τ. ἔργα τ. διαβόλου, [[1Jn.3.8|1Jn.3:8]] τ. ὠδῖνας τ. θανάτου, [[Act.2.24|Act.2:24]] of laws, etc., **to break, annul, cancel **(MM, xvi): ἐντολήν, [[Mat.5.19|Mat.5:19]] τ. νόμον, [[Jhn.7.23|Jhn.7:23]] τ. σάββατον, [[Jhn.5.18|Jhn.5:18]] τ. γραφήν, [[Jhn.10.35|Jhn.10:35]]
(cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-λύω.)
(AS)

G3056.def:
**λόγος**, -ου, ὁ (λέγω)
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר, also for מִלָּה ,אֵמֶר, etc. ;]
I. Of that by which the inward thought is expressed, Lat. oratio, sermo, vox, verbum.
1. **a word**, not in the grammatical sense of a mere name (ἔπος, ὄνομα, ῥῆμα), but a word as embodying a conception or idea: [[Mat.8.8|Mat.8:8]], [[Luk.7.7|Luk.7:7]], [[1Co.14.9, 19|1Co.14:9, 19]] [[Heb.12.19|Heb.12:19]], al.
2. **a saying, statement, declaration**: [[Mat.19.22|Mat.19:22]] (T om.), [[Mrk.5.36; 7.29|Mrk.5:36 7:29]], [[Luk.1.29|Luk.1:29]], [[Jhn.2.22; 6.60|Jhn.2:22 6:60]], [[Act.7.29|Act.7:29]], al.; with genitive attrib., [[Act.13.15|Act.13:15]], [[Rom.9.9|Rom.9:9]], [[Heb.7.28|Heb.7:28]], al.; of the sayings, commands, promises, etc., of teachers, [[Mat.7.24; 10.14|Mat.7:24 10:14]], [[Mrk.8.38|Mrk.8:38]], [[Luk.9.4|Luk.9:4]], [[Jhn.14.24|Jhn.14:24]], al.; λ. κενοί, [[Eph.5.6|Eph.5:6]] ἀληθινοί, [[Rev.19.9|Rev.19:9]] πιστοί, [[Rev.22.6|Rev.22:6]] esp. of the precepts, decrees and promises of God, ὁ λ. τ. θεοῦ, **the word of God**: [[Mrk.7.13|Mrk.7:13]], [[Jhn.10.35|Jhn.10:35]], [[Rom.13.9|Rom.13:9]], [[1Co.14.36|1Co.14:36]], [[Php.1.14|Php.1:14]], al.; absol., ὁ λ., [[Mat.13.21, 22|Mat.13:21, 22]] Mrk.16:[20], [[Luk.1.2|Luk.1:2]], [[Act.6.4|Act.6:4]], [[Heb.4.12|Heb.4:12]], al.
3. **speech, discourse**: [[Act.14.12|Act.14:12]], [[2Co.10.10|2Co.10:10]], [[Jas.3.2|Jas.3:2]]; opposite to ἐπιστολή, [[2Th.2.15|2Th.2:15]] disting, from σοφία, [[1Co.2.1|1Co.2:1]] ἀναστροφή, [[1Ti.4.12|1Ti.4:12]] δύναμις, [[1Co.4.19|1Co.4:19]], [[1Th.1.5|1Th.1:5]]; ἔργον, [[Rom.15.18|Rom.15:18]] οὐδενὸς λ. τίμιον (**not worthy of mention**), [[Act.20.24|Act.20:24]] of the faculty of speech, [[Luk.24.19|Luk.24:19]], [[2Co.11.6|2Co.11:6]]; of the style of speech, [[Mat.5.37|Mat.5:37]], [[1Co.1.5|1Co.1:5]]; of instruction, [[Col.4.3|Col.4:3]], [[1Pe.3.1|1Pe.3:1]]; with genitive of person(s), [[Jhn.5.24; 8.52|Jhn.5:24 8:52]], [[Act.2.41|Act.2:41]], al.; ὁ λ. ὁ ἐμός, [[Jhn.8.31|Jhn.8:31]] with genitive obj. (τ.) ἀληθείας, [[2Co.6.7|2Co.6:7]], [[Col.1.5|Col.1:5]], [[Jas.1.18|Jas.1:18]]; τ. καταλλαγῆς, [[2Co.5.19|2Co.5:19]] τ. σταυροῦ, [[1Co.1.18|1Co.1:18]] of mere talk, [[1Co.4.19|1Co.4:19]], 2o, [[Col.2.23|Col.2:23]], [[1Jn.3.18|1Jn.3:18]] of the talk which one occasions, hence, **repute**: [[Col.2.23|Col.2:23]]
4. subject-matter, hence, **teaching, doctrine**: [[Act.18.15|Act.18:15]], [[2Ti.2.17|2Ti.2:17]], al.; esp. of Christian doctrine: [[Mat.13.20-23|Mat.13:20-23]], [[Mrk.4.14-20; 8.32|Mrk.4:14-20 8:32]], [[Luk.1.2|Luk.1:2]], [[Act.8.4|Act.8:4]], [[Gal.6.6|Gal.6:6]], [[1Th.1.6|1Th.1:6]], al.; with genitive of person(s), τ. θεοῦ, [[Luk.5.1|Luk.5:1]], [[Jhn.17.6|Jhn.17:6]], [[Act.4.29|Act.4:29]], [[1Co.14.36|1Co.14:36]], I [[Jhn.1.10|Jhn.1:10]], [[Rev.6.9|Rev.6:9]], al.; τ. Κυρίου, [[Act.8.25|Act.8:25]], [[1Th.1.8|1Th.1:8]], al.; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[Col.3.16|Col.3:16]], [[Rev.3.8|Rev.3:8]]; with genitive appos., [[Act.15.7|Act.15:7]] with genitive attrib., [[Heb.5.13|Heb.5:13]]
5. **a story, tale, narrative**: [[Mat.28.15|Mat.28:15]], [[Jhn.21.23|Jhn.21:23]], [[Act.1.1; 11.22|Act.1:1 11:22]]; before περί, [[Luk.5.15|Luk.5:15]]
6. That which is spoken of (Plat., al.; V. Kennedy, _Sources_, 124), **matter, affair, thing**: [[Mat.21.24|Mat.21:24]], [[Mrk.1.45; 11.29|Mrk.1:45 11:29]], [[Luk.20.3|Luk.20:3]], [[Act.8.21|Act.8:21]]; of a matter in dispute, as a case or suit at law, [[Act.19.38|Act.19:38]] pl. ([[1Ma.7.33|1Ma.7:33]], al.), [[Luk.1.4|Luk.1:4]].
II. Of the inward thought itself, Lat. ratio.
1. **reason**,
(a) **of the mental faculty **(Hdt., Plat., al.): κατὰ λόγον, [[Act.18.14|Act.18:14]]
(b) **a reason, cause**: τίνι λόγῳ, [[Act.10.29|Act.10:29]] παρεκτὸς λόγου πορνείας, [[Mat.5.32; 19.9|Mat.5:32 19:9]], WH, mg., R, mg.
2. **account**,
(a) **regard**: [[Act.20.24|Act.20:24]], Rec.;
(b) **reckoning**: [[Php.4.15, 17|Php.4:15, 17]]; συναίρειν (which see) λ., [[Mat.18.23; 25.19|Mat.18:23 25:19]]; in forensic sense, [[Rom.14.12|Rom.14:12]], [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], [[1Pe.4.5|1Pe.4:5]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[Luk.16.2|Luk.16:2]] before περί, [[Mat.12.36|Mat.12:36]], [[Act.19.40|Act.19:40]], [[1Pe.3.15|1Pe.3:15]].
3. **proportion, analogy**: [[Php.2.16|Php.2:16]] (Field, _Notes_, 193 f.).
III. ὁ λ., the Divine **Word** or **Logos**: [[Jhn.1.1, 14|Jhn.1:1, 14]]; τ. ζωῆς, [[1Jn.1.1|1Jn.1:1]] τ. θεοῦ, [[Rev.19.13|Rev.19:13]] (see Westc, Swete, _CGT_, in ll.; reff. in Artt., _Logos_, _DB_, _DCG_).
(AS)

G3022.def:
**λευκο-βύσσινος**, -ον
(cf. λευκολινής, a robe of white flax, C.I., 155, 17),
**white linen**: [[Rev.19.14|Rev.19:14]] (WH, mg.).†
λευκός, ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for לָבָן ;]
1. **bright, brilliant**: of clothing, [[Mat.17.2|Mat.17:2]], [[Mrk.9.3; 16.5|Mrk.9:3 16:5]], [[Luk.9.29|Luk.9:29]], [[Act.1.10|Act.1:10]], [[Rev.3.5; 4.4; 6.11; 7.9, 13; 19.14|Rev.3:5 4:4 6:11 7:9, 13 19:14]] (cf. [[Ecc.9.8|Ecc.9:8]]); ὡς χιών, [[Mat.28.3|Mat.28:3]] ἐν λ.. (sc. ἱματίοις), [[Jhn.20.12|Jhn.20:12]], [[Rev.3.4|Rev.3:4]]; θρόνος, [[Rev.20.11|Rev.20:11]]
2. **white**: [[Mat.5.36|Mat.5:36]], [[Rev.1.14; 2.17; 4.4; 6.2; 14.14; 19.11|Rev.1:14 2:17 4:4 6:2 14:14 19:11]]; figuratively, of garments, [[Rev.3.18|Rev.3:18]] of ripened grain, [[Jhn.4.35|Jhn.4:35]]†
(AS)

G3015.def:
**λεπρός**, -ά, -όν
(λεπίς), [in LXX for צָרַע ;]
1. (in cl.) scaly, rough.
2. **leprous**; chiefly as subst., ὁ λ., **a leper**: [[Mat.8.2; 10.8; 11.5|Mat.8:2 10:8 11:5]], [[Mrk.1.40|Mrk.1:40]], [[Luk.4.27; 7.22; 17.12|Luk.4:27 7:22 17:12]]; of Simon, formerly a leper, [[Mat.26.6|Mat.26:6]], [[Mrk.14.3|Mrk.14:3]].†
(AS)

G3043.def:
**λίνον**
(Tr. λῖνον), -ου, τό [in LXX: [[Exo.9.31|Exo.9:31]] (פִּשְׁתָּה), al. ;]
1. **flax**: [[Mat.12.20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX).
2. **linen**: [[Rev.15.6|Rev.15:6]] (R, mg., see: λίθος).†
**λίθος**, -ου, ὁ
(and, in Att.., of precious stones, ἡ.) [in LXX for אֶבֶן, [[Gen.11.3|Gen.11:3]], al.; λ. τίμιος, for פָּז, [[Psa.19.10; 21.3|Psa.19:10 21:3]], [[Pro.8.19|Pro.8:19]], al. ;]
**a stone**: [[Mat.4.6|Mat.4:6]], al.; pl., [[Mat.3.9|Mat.3:9]], al.; at the entrance of a tomb, [[Mat.27.60, 66; 28.2|Mat.27:60, 66 28:2]], [[Mrk.15.46; 16.3-4|Mrk.15:46 16:3-4]], [[Luk.24.2|Luk.24:2]], [[Jhn.11.38, 32; 11.41; 20.1|Jhn.11:38, 32 11:41 20:1]]; λ. μυλικός, [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]], cf. [[Rev.18.21|Rev.18:21]] of building stones, [[Mat.21.42|Mat.21:42]], [44], [[Mat.24.2|Mat.24:2]], [[Mrk.12.10; 13.1-2|Mrk.12:10 13:1-2]], [[Luk.19.44; 20.17-18; 21.5-6|Luk.19:44 20:17-18 21:5-6]] [[Act.4.11|Act.4:11]], [[1Pe.2.7|1Pe.2:7]]; metaphorically, of Christ, λ. ἀκρογωναῖος, ἐκλεκτός, ἔντιμος, [[1Pe.2.6|1Pe.2:6]] (LXX); λ. ζῶν, [[1Pe.2.4|1Pe.2:4]] προσκόμματος, [[1Pe.2.8|1Pe.2:8]], [[Rom.9.33|Rom.9:33]]; of Christians, λ. ζῶντες, [[1Pe.2.5|1Pe.2:5]] of precious stones, λ. τίμιος, [[Rev.17.4; 18.12, 16; 21.11, 19|Rev.17:4 18:12, 16 21:11, 19]]; ἴασπις, [[Rev.4.3|Rev.4:3]] ἐνδεδυμένοι λ. καθαρόν, [[Rev.15.6|Rev.15:6]] (λίνον, Rec., R, mg., see Swete, in l); metaphorically, λ. τίμιοι, [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]] of the tables of the law, [[2Co.3.7|2Co.3:7]] of idols, [[Act.17.29|Act.17:29]]
(AS)

G3001.def:
**λάχανον**, -ου, τό
(λαχαίνω, to dig), [in LXX: [[Gen.9.3|Gen.9:3]] [[1Ki.21.2|3Ki.21:2]], [[Psa.37.2|Psa.37:2]], [[Pro.15.17|Pro.15:17]] (יֶרֶק, יָרָק) * ;]
**a garden herb, vegetable**: [[Luk.11.42|Luk.11:42]] usually in pl., [[Mat.13.32|Mat.13:32]], [[Mrk.4.32|Mrk.4:32]], [[Rom.14.2|Rom.14:2]].†
_SYN._: βοτάνη, q.v (AS)

G3093.def:
**Μαγαδάν**
**Magadan, an unidentified place on the coast of the Sea of Galilee**: [[Mat.15.39|Mat.15:39]] (Rec. Μαγδαλά; cf. [[Mrk.8.10|Mrk.8:10]], where for Δαλμανουθά, D* has Μελεγαδά, D1 Μαγαιδά, some cursives Μαγαδά, and Euseb. Onomast. Μεγαιδάν; cf. _DB_, iii, see word).†
**Μαγδαλά** (Aram. מַגְדְֺּלָא = _Heb._ H4026, which in [[Jos.15.37|Jos.15:37]] B is rendered Μαγαδά),
**Magdala**: [[Mat.15.39|Mat.15:39]] (Rec. for Μαγαδάν, which see).†
(AS)

G3083.def:
**λύτρον**, -ον, τό
(λύω), [in LXX (Pent. .15 Pr .2, Isa .1) for פִּדְיוֹם and cogn. forms, גְּאֻלָּה, כֹּפֶר, מְחִיר ;]
a ransom (as for a life, [[Exo.21.30|Exo.21:30]] for slaves, [[Lev.19.20|Lev.19:20]] for captives, [[Isa.45.13|Isa.45:13]]): ἀντὶ πολλῶν, [[Mat.20.28|Mat.20:28]], [[Mrk.10.45|Mrk.10:45]] (see Swete, in l, and for discussion of λ. and its cognates, Westc., He., 295 f.; Deiss., _LAE_, 331 f.; cf. also ἀντί-λύτρον).†
(AS)

G3025.def:
**ληνός**, -οῦ, ἡ
(in some MSS., LXX and NT, ὁ), [in LXX chiefly for יֶקֶב [[Num.18.27|Num.18:27]], al.; also for רַהַט ([[Gen.30.38, 41|Gen.30:38, 41]]), גַּת ([[Neh.13.15|Neh.13:15]], al.), etc. ;]
**a trough or vat**; esp. for the treading of grapes: [[Mat.21.33|Mat.21:33]], [[Rev.14.20; 19.16|Rev.14:20 19:16]]; τὴν λ. . . . τὸν μέγαν (a solecism perhaps inadvertent), [[Rev.14.19|Rev.14:19]] (cf. ὑπολήνιον).†
(AS)

G3036.def:
**λιθο-βολέω**, -ῶ
(λίθος, βάλλω), [in LXX for סָקַל, רָגַם, [[Exo.19.13|Exo.19:13]], [[Lev.20.2|Lev.20:2]], al. ;]
**to pelt with stones, to kill by stoning, to stone **(cf. λιθάζω): with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.21.35; 23.37|Mat.21:35 23:37]], [[Luk.13.34|Luk.13:34]] [[Act.7.58-59; 14.5|Act.7:58-59 14:5]]; pass., [[Heb.12.20|Heb.12:20]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G3039.def:
**λικμάω**, -ῶ
(λικμός = λίκνον, a winnowing-fan), [in LXX chiefly for זָרָה ni., pi., [[Rut.3.2|Rut.3:2]] [[1Ki.14.15|3Ki.14:15]], [[Isa.17.13|Isa.17:13]], [[Jer.31.10|Jer.31:10]], [[Dan.2.44|Dan.2:44]], al. ;]
1. in cl., to winnow (so Ru, l.with).
2. In LXX (ll with, exc. Ru), **to scatter **(as chaff or dust): [[Luk.20.18|Luk.20:18]] (RV, scatter as dust, Deiss., BS, 225 f., quotes ex. in π. which suggests the meaning ruin, destroy; cf. Vg. comminuet, AV, grind to powder; cf. also Kennedy, _Sources_, 126), [[Mat.21.44|Mat.21:44]] [WH], R, txt.†
(AS)

G3062.def:
**λοιπός**, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
**the remaining, the rest, **
1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., [[Mat.25.11|Mat.25:11]], [[Act.2.37|Act.2:37]], [[Rom.1.13|Rom.1:13]], al.; absol., [[Mat.22.6|Mat.22:6]], [[Mrk.16.13|Mrk.16:13]], [[Luk.24.10|Luk.24:10]], al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), [[Act.28.9|Act.28:9]], [[1Th.4.13|1Th.4:13]], [[Rev.2.24|Rev.2:24]]; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]] τὰ λ., [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]], [[Rev.3.2|Rev.3:2]], al.
2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
(a) **for the future, henceforth**: [[Mrk.14.41|Mrk.14:41]], [[1Co.7.29|1Co.7:29]] (Lft., _Notes_, 232 f.), [[Heb.10.13|Heb.10:13]] anarth. (Deiss., _LAE_, 17616, 1885, 20), [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]], [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]]; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, _Pr._, 73; Bl., § 36, 13), [[Gal.6.17|Gal.6:17]], [[Eph.6.10|Eph.6:10]];
(b) **besides, moreover, for the rest**: [[Php.3.1; 4.8|Php.3:1 4:8]]; anarth., [[1Co.1.16; 4.2|1Co.1:16 4:2]], [[1Th.4.1|1Th.4:1]] (M, _Th._, in l; Lft., _Notes_, 51)
(AS)

G3063.def:
**λοιπός**, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
**the remaining, the rest, **
1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., [[Mat.25.11|Mat.25:11]], [[Act.2.37|Act.2:37]], [[Rom.1.13|Rom.1:13]], al.; absol., [[Mat.22.6|Mat.22:6]], [[Mrk.16.13|Mrk.16:13]], [[Luk.24.10|Luk.24:10]], al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), [[Act.28.9|Act.28:9]], [[1Th.4.13|1Th.4:13]], [[Rev.2.24|Rev.2:24]]; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]] τὰ λ., [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]], [[Rev.3.2|Rev.3:2]], al.
2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
(a) **for the future, henceforth**: [[Mrk.14.41|Mrk.14:41]], [[1Co.7.29|1Co.7:29]] (Lft., _Notes_, 232 f.), [[Heb.10.13|Heb.10:13]] anarth. (Deiss., _LAE_, 17616, 1885, 20), [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]], [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]]; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, _Pr._, 73; Bl., § 36, 13), [[Gal.6.17|Gal.6:17]], [[Eph.6.10|Eph.6:10]];
(b) **besides, moreover, for the rest**: [[Php.3.1; 4.8|Php.3:1 4:8]]; anarth., [[1Co.1.16; 4.2|1Co.1:16 4:2]], [[1Th.4.1|1Th.4:1]] (M, _Th._, in l; Lft., _Notes_, 51)
(AS)

G3017.def:
**Λευεί (indecl.) and Λευείς (Rec. -υΐ, -υΐς), genitive Λευεί, accusative -είν, ὁ (Heb. H3878) **
**Levi**;
1. **the son of Jacob**: [[Heb.7.5|Heb.7:5]], 9, [[Rev.7.7|Rev.7:7]].
2. **Son of Melchi**: [[Luk.3.24|Luk.3:24]]
3. **Son of Simeon**: [[Luk.3.29|Luk.3:29]]
4. **Son of Alphæus **(cf. Μαθθαῖος): [[Mrk.2.14|Mrk.2:14]] (WH, mg., Ἰάκωβον), [[Luk.5.27, 29|Luk.5:27, 29]].†
(AS)

G3021.def:
**λευκαίνω**
(λευκός), [in LXX: [[Psa.51.7|Psa.51:7]], [[Isa.1.18|Isa.1:18]] (לָבַן hi.), etc. ;]
**to whiten, make white**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.9.3|Mrk.9:3]], [[Rev.7.14|Rev.7:14]].†
(AS)

G3016.def:
**λεπτός**, -ή, -όν
(λέπω, to peel),
1. peeled.
2. **fine, thin, small, light**; hence, in late Gk., as subst. τὸ λ., **a small coin **(one-eighth of an as, AV, mite): [[Mrk.12.42|Mrk.12:42]], [[Luk.12.59; 21.2|Luk.12:59 21:2]].†
(AS)

G3009.def:
**λειτουργία**, -ας, ἡ
(λειτουργέω), [in LXX chiefly for עֲבֹדָה, [[Num.4.24|Num.4:24]], [[1Ch.9.13|1Ch.9:13]], al. ;]
1. in cl. (chiefly of Athens), the discharge of a public office at one's own expense (see LS, see word), hence,
2. **a service, ministry**; in π. (Deiss., BS, 140 f.) and in LXX (though here also of secular service, [[1Ki.1.4|3Ki.1:4]], al.), of religious service or ministration; and so in NT: of priestly ministrations, [[Luk.1.23|Luk.1:23]], [[Heb.8.6; 9.21|Heb.8:6 9:21]]; figuratively, θυσία καὶ λ. τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, [[Php.2.17|Php.2:17]] of Christian beneficence, [[2Co.9.12|2Co.9:12]], [[Php.2.30|Php.2:30]].†
(AS)

G3085.def:
**λύτρωσις**, -εως, ἡ
(λυτρόω), [in LXX: [[Lev.25.29, 48|Lev.25:29, 48]], [[Isa.63.4|Isa.63:4]] גְּאֻלָּה), [[Num.18.16|Num.18:16]], [[Psa.49.8; 111.9; 130.7|Psa.49:8 111:9 130:7]] (פָּדָה, פִּדְיוֹם, פְּדוּת), [[Jdg.1.15|Jdg.1:15]] * ;]
**a ransoming, redemption **(αἰχμαλώτων, Plut., Arat., 11): of the mediatorial work of Christ, [[Heb.9.12|Heb.9:12]] in general sense, deliverance(cf. [[Psa.4.8|Psa.4:8]], l.with): [[Luk.1.68; 2.38|Luk.1:68 2:38]].†
(AS)

G3019.def:
**Λευείτης**
(Rec. Λευΐτης), -ου, ὁ [in LXX for לֵוִיִּי ;]
**a Levite**: [[Luk.10.32|Luk.10:32]], [[Jhn.1.19|Jhn.1:19]], [[Act.4.36|Act.4:36]].†
(AS)

G3081.def:
**λυσιτελέω**, -ῶ
(λυσιτελής, useful, prop., τὰ τέλη λύων), [in LXX: [[Tob.3.6|Tob.3:6]], [[Sir.20.10, 14; 29.11|Sir.20:10, 14 29:11]] * ;]
1. prop., to indemnify, pay expenses.
2. **to be useful, to profit**; usually impers., λυσιτελεῖ, **it profits**: with, dative of person(s), before εἰ . . . ἤ, [[Luk.17.2|Luk.17:2]]†
(AS)

G3007.def:
**λείπω **
[in LXX: [[Job.4.11|Job.4:11]], [[Pro.19.4|Pro.19:4]] (פָּרַד), al. ;]
1. trans., to leave, leave behind; pass., to be left behind, to lack before prep. (as more usual in cl.), ἐν, [[Jas.1.4|Jas.1:4]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Jas.1.5; 2.15|Jas.1:5 2:15]].
2. Intrans., **to be gone, to be wanting**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.18.22|Luk.18:22]], [[Tit.3.13|Tit.3:13]]; τὰ λείποντα, [[Tit.1.5|Tit.1:5]]
(cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, ἐν-κατα-, περι-, ὑπο-λείπω).†
(AS)

G3061.def:
**λοιμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for לוּץ, עָרִיץ, בְּלִיַּעַל, etc. ;]
**pestilence**: pl., [[Luk.21.11|Luk.21:11]] metaphorically (as in cl.; LXX: [[Psa.1.1|Psa.1:1]], [[Pro.21.24|Pro.21:24]], [[1Ma.15.21|1Ma.15:21]], al.), of persons, **a pest**: [[Act.24.5|Act.24:5]] (also as adj., ἄνδρες λοιμοί, [[1Ma.10.61|1Ma.10:61]], al.).†
(AS)

G3077.def:
**λύπη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for עֶצֶב and cogn. forms, etc. ;]
**pain of body or mind, grief, sorrow**: [[Jhn.16.6|Jhn.16:6]], [[2Co.2.7|2Co.2:7]]; opposite to χαρά, [[Jhn.16.20|Jhn.16:20]], [[Heb.12.11|Heb.12:11]]; ἀπὸ τῆς λ., [[Luk.22.45|Luk.22:45]] ἐκ λ., [[2Co.9.7|2Co.9:7]] ἡ κατὰ θεὸν λ., opposite to ἡ τ. κόσ-μου λ., [[2Co.7.10|2Co.7:10]] λ. μοι ἐστιν, [[Rom.9.2|Rom.9:2]] λ. ἔχω, [[Jhn.16.21-22;|Jhn.16:21-22]] id. before ἀπό, [[2Co.2.3|2Co.2:3]] λ. ἐπὶ λ. ἔχω, [[Php.2.27|Php.2:27]] ἐν λ. ἐλθεῖν, [[2Co.2.1|2Co.2:1]] (to come sad and cause sadness); pl. (cf. [[Gen.3.16|Gen.3:16]], [[Pro.15.13|Pro.15:13]], al.), [[1Pe.2.19|1Pe.2:19]].†
(AS)

G3084.def:
**λυτρόω**, -ῶ
(λύτρον, which see), [in LXX chiefly for פָּדָה, גָּאַל ;]
**to release on receipt of ransom**; mid., **to release by paying ransom, to redeem**: in spiritual sense, [[Tit.2.14|Tit.2:14]] pass, [[1Pe.1.18|1Pe.1:18]] in general sense, to deliver (cf. [[Exo.6.6|Exo.6:6]], [[Psa.69.18|Psa.69:18]], al.): [[Luk.24.21|Luk.24:21]].†
(AS)

G3058.def:
**λοιδορέω**, -ῶ
(λοίδορος) [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
**to abuse, revile**: with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.9.28|Jhn.9:28]], [[Act.23.4|Act.23:4]]; pass., [[1Co.4.12|1Co.4:12]], [[1Pe.2.23|1Pe.2:23]] (cf. ἀντι-λοιδορέω).†
(AS)

G3034.def:
**λιθάζω**
(λίθος), [in LXX (before ἐν λίθοις): [[2Ki.16.6; 16.13|2Ki.16:6 16:13]] (סָקַל pi.)* ;]
1. to throw stones (Arist., Polyb., al.).
2. = λιθοβολέω (LXX, NT), **to pelt with stones, to stone**: with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.8.6; 10.31-31; 11.8|Jhn.8:6 10:31-31 11:8]], [[Act.14.10|Act.14:10]]; pass., [[Act.5.26|Act.5:26]], [[2Co.11.25|2Co.11:25]], [[Heb.11.37|Heb.11:37]] (see _DB_, Art., " Crimes and punish­ments," and cf. κατα-λιθάζω).†
(AS)

G3046.def:
**λίτρα**, -ας, ἡ
(cf. Lat. libra),
1. a Sicilian coin = Rom. libra or as.
2. **In weight, a pound**: [[Jhn.12.3; 19.39|Jhn.12:3 19:39]].†
(AS)

G3068.def:
**λούω **
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַץ (frequently of ceremonial washing; cf. Deiss., BS, 226 f.) ;]
**to bathe, wash the body**: with accusative of person(s), [[Act.9.37|Act.9:37]] (of a dead body); id. before ἀπό (Deiss., BS, l.with), [[Act.16.33|Act.16:33]] pass. ptcp. pf., [[Jhn.13.10|Jhn.13:10]], [[Heb.10.22|Heb.10:22]]; mid., to wash oneself (Mayor, in l; M. _Pr._, 155 f., 238 f.), [[2Pe.2.22|2Pe.2:22]] metaphorically, [[Rev.1.5|Rev.1:5]], Rec., R, mg. (cf. ἀπο-λούω).†
_SYN._: νίπτω, used of parts of the body-hands, feet, face; πλύνω, of things, as garments, etc. (see [[Lev.15.11|Lev.15:11]] cf. Tr., _Syn._, § xlv) (AS)

G3038.def:
**λιθό-στρωτος**, -ον
(στρώννυμι), [in LXX: [[2Ch.7.3|2Ch.7:3]], [[Est.1.6|Est.1:6]], [[Sng.3.10|Sng.3:10]] (רִצְפָּה, רָצַף)* ;]
paved with stones, esp. of tessallated work (Ca, i.e.); as subst., τὸ λ., **a tessallated pavement**: [[Jhn.19.13|Jhn.19:13]] (cf. Γαββαθᾶ).†
(AS)

G3057.def:
**λόγχη**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for רֹמַח, etc. ;]
1. a spear-head.
2. **a lance, spear**: [[Mat.27.49|Mat.27:49]] ([WH], R, mg.), [[Jhn.19.34|Jhn.19:34]]†
(AS)

G3033.def: **Libya, the north part of Africa ** west of Egypt, (Odyssey by Homer); in later writers also for the whole Continent (ML)

G3032.def:
**Λιβερῖτνος**, -ου, ὁ (Lat. libertinus),
**a freedman**: ἡ συναγωγὴ ἡ λεγομένη Λιβερτίνων [[Act.6.9|Act.6:9]] (Bl. thinks the original reading was Λιβυστίνων, Phil. Gosp., 69 f.).†
(AS)

G3099.def:
**Μαδιάμ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִדְיָן),
**Midian**;
1. son of Abraham ([[Gen.25.2|Gen.25:2]]).
2. An Arabian tribe ([[Gen.36.35|Gen.36:35]], [[Psa.83.9|Psa.83:9]], al).
3. γῆ Μ. (Heb. מִדְיָן אֶרֶץ), the land of Midian ([[Exo.2.15|Exo.2:15]], al.): [[Act.7.29|Act.7:29]].†
(AS)

G3086.def:
**λυτρωτής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(λυτρόω), [in LXX: of God, [[Psa.19.14; 78.35|Psa.19:14 78:35]] (גָּאַל)* ;]
**a redeemer, deliverer**: [[Act.7.35|Act.7:35]] (not found elsewhere).†
(AS)

G3051.def:
**λόγιον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of λόγος, see _ICC_, Ro., 70), [in LXX chiefly for אִמְרָה, אֵמֶר, [[Psa.18.30; 19.14|Psa.18:30 19:14]], al.; also for דָּבָר, [[Isa.28.13|Isa.28:13]], al.; (cf. λογεῖον (-ιον) for חֹשֶׁן the oracular breastplate of the H.P., [[Exo.28.15|Exo.28:15]], al.) ;]
**an oracle**: [[Act.7.38|Act.7:38]], [[Rom.3.2|Rom.3:2]], [[Heb.5.12|Heb.5:12]], [[1Pe.4.11|1Pe.4:11]] (on the eccl., λόγια τ. Κυρίου, see Lft., Essay on Sup. Rel., 172 ff.).†
(AS)

G3075.def:
**λυμαίνομαι**
(λύμη, outrage), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת pi., hi., also for כִּרְסֵם, etc. ;]
1. **to outrage, maltreat**: with accusative, [[Act.8.3|Act.8:3]]
2. to corrupt, defile ([[Ezk.16.25|Eze.16:25]], [[Pro.23.8|Pro.23:8]], [[4Ma.18.8|4Ma.18:8]], al.).†
(AS)

G3096.def:
**μαγεύω** (Eur., Plut., al.),
1. to be a Magus, or skilled in Magian lore.
2. **to practise magic**: [[Act.8.9|Act.8:9]]†
(AS)

G3095.def:
**μαγία** (Rec. -εία), -ας, ἡ
(μάγος),
1. the lore of the Magians (Plat.).
2. **magic**: pl., **magic arts, sorceries**: [[Act.8.11|Act.8:11]]†
(AS)

G3013.def:
**λεπίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
(λέπω, to peel) [in LXX chiefly for קַשְׂקֶשֶׂת ;]
**a scale**: [[Act.9.18|Act.9:18]]†
(AS)

G3069.def:
**λύδδα**, -ας ([[Act.9.38|Act.9:38]], -ης Rec.), ἡ and λύδδα, -ων, τά ([[Act.9.32, 35|Act.9:32, 35]]; -αν, Rec.), (Heb. לֹד),
**Lydda **(modern Ludd): Ac, ll. with†
(AS)

G3008.def:
**λειτουργέω**, -ῶ
(λειτουργός), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת pi., also for עָבַד, צָבָא, etc. ;]
1. in cl., at Athens, to supply public offices at one's own cost, render public service to the State, hence, generally,
2. **to serve the State, do a service, serve **(of service to the Gods, Diod., i, 21): of the official service of priests and Levites ([[Exo.29.30|Exo.29:30]], [[Num.16.9|Num.16:9]], [[Sir.4.14|Sir.4:14]], [[1Ma.10.42|1Ma.10:42]], al.; cf. Deiss., BS, 140 f.), [[Heb.10.11|Heb.10:11]] of Christians: with dative of person(s) before ἐν, [[Rom.15.27|Rom.15:27]] (cf. [[Sir.10.25|Sir.10:25]]); τ. κυρίῳ, [[Act.13.2|Act.13:2]]†
_SYN._: λατρεύω (which see), prop., to serve for hire, LXX (as some­times in cl.), always of service to the deity on the part of both priests and people ([[Exo.4.3|Exo.4:3]], [[Deu.10.12|Deu.10:12]], and similarly in NT). λειτουργέω "is the fulfilment of an office: it has a definite representative character, and corresponds with a function to be discharged". It is therefore used of serving in an office or ministry: in LXX always of priests and Levites, in NT, with its cognates ([[Rom.13.6; 15.27|Rom.13:6 15:27]], are not really exceptions), of services rendered either to God or man by apostles, prophets, teachers, and other officers of the church (cf. Tr., _Syn._, § xxxv; _ICC_ on [[Rom.1.9|Rom.1:9]] Westc., He., 232 ff.) (AS)

G3071.def:
**Λυκαονία**, -ας, ἡ
**Lycaonia, a region in Asia Minor**: [[Act.14.6|Act.14:6]]†
(AS)

G3052.def:
**λόγιος**, -ον
(λόγος),
1. in cl., learned (Ac, l.with, R, txt.).
2. In late Gk., **eloquent**: [[Act.18.24|Act.18:24]] (see Page, in l; Field, _Notes_, 129).†
(AS)

G3073.def:
**Λυκία**, -ας, ἡ
**Lydia**, a region of Asia Minor; [[Act.27.5|Act.27:5]]†
(AS)

G3047.def:
**λίψ**, λιβός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶב, also for תֵּימָן, מַעֲרָב, etc., [[Gen.13.14|Gen.13:14]], [[Num.2.10|Num.2:10]], [[2Ch.32.30|2Ch.32:30]], al. ;]
the SW. wind: βλέποντα κατὰ λ., [[Act.27.12|Act.27:12]] (see Page, in l; Deiss., ES, 141).†
(AS)

G3005.def:
**λεῖμμα** (WH, λίμμα, see their _App._, 154), -τος, τό
(λείπω), [in LXX: [[2Ki.19.4|4Ki.19:4]] A (שְׁאֵרִית)* ;]
**a remnant**: [[Rom.11.5|Rom.11:5]]†
(AS)

G3050.def:
**λογικός**, -ή, -όν
(λόγος, reason)
**reasonable, rational**: λατρεία, [[Rom.12.1|Rom.12:1]] τὸ λ. (i.e. spiritual) γάλα (see Hort, in l; MM, xvi), [[1Pe.2.2|1Pe.2:2]] (in support of AV, milk of the word, see _ICC_, in l).†
(AS)

G3011.def:
**λειτουργός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(λιός, ἔργον), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁרַת, [[Jos.1.1|Jos.1:1]] A, [[3Ki.10.5|3Ki.10:5]], [[Psa.103.21|Psa.103:21]], [[Sir.7.30|Sir.7:30]], al. ;]
1. in cl., one who discharges a public office at his own expense, then, generally,
2. **a public servant, a minister, servant**: τ. ἁγίων λ., [[Heb.8.2|Heb.8:2]] (cf. [[Neh.10.39|Neh.10:39]], Sir, l.with); Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, [[Rom.15.16|Rom.15:16]] pl., τ. θεοῦ, [[Rom.13.6|Rom.13:6]], [[Heb.1.7|Heb.1:7]]" (LXX) ; λ. ὑμῶν τ. χρείας μου, [[Php.2.25|Php.2:25]]†
_SYN._: see: διάκονος, λειτουργέω (AS)

G3080.def:
**λύσις**, -εως, ἡ
(λύω), [in LXX: [[Ecc.8.1|Ecc.8:1]] ([[Ecc.8.1|Ecc.8:1]]) (פֵּשֶׁר), Dan LXX 12:8, [[Wis.8.8|Wis.8:8]] * ;]
**a loosing**: of divorce, [[1Co.7.27|1Co.7:27]]†
(AS)

G3048.def:
**λογία**
(prop., -εία, see BS, 142 ff.), -ας, ἡ (λογεύω, to collect, a word found in π., see Deiss., BS, l.with; _LAE_, 70, 103; MM, xvi),
**a collection**: [[1Co.16.1-2|1Co.16:1-2]]†
(AS)

G3064.def:
**λοιπός**, -ή, -όν
(λείπω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתַר, also for שְׁאָר, etc. ;]
**the remaining, the rest, **
1. pl., οἱ λ.: with subst., [[Mat.25.11|Mat.25:11]], [[Act.2.37|Act.2:37]], [[Rom.1.13|Rom.1:13]], al.; absol., [[Mat.22.6|Mat.22:6]], [[Mrk.16.13|Mrk.16:13]], [[Luk.24.10|Luk.24:10]], al.; οἱ λ. οἱ (B1., § 47, 8), [[Act.28.9|Act.28:9]], [[1Th.4.13|1Th.4:13]], [[Rev.2.24|Rev.2:24]]; οἱ λ. τ. ἀνθρώπων (LS, see word, ad. init.), [[Rev.9.20|Rev.9:20]] τὰ λ., [[Mrk.4.19|Mrk.4:19]], [[Rev.3.2|Rev.3:2]], al.
2. Neut. sing. (accusative ref.), adverbially, τὸ λ.;
(a) **for the future, henceforth**: [[Mrk.14.41|Mrk.14:41]], [[1Co.7.29|1Co.7:29]] (Lft., _Notes_, 232 f.), [[Heb.10.13|Heb.10:13]] anarth. (Deiss., _LAE_, 17616, 1885, 20), [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]], [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]]; τοῦ λ. (sc. χρόνου; LS, see word; M, _Pr._, 73; Bl., § 36, 13), [[Gal.6.17|Gal.6:17]], [[Eph.6.10|Eph.6:10]];
(b) **besides, moreover, for the rest**: [[Php.3.1; 4.8|Php.3:1 4:8]]; anarth., [[1Co.1.16; 4.2|1Co.1:16 4:2]], [[1Th.4.1|1Th.4:1]] (M, _Th._, in l; Lft., _Notes_, 51)
(AS)

G3067.def:
**λουτρόν**, -οῦ, τό
(λούω), [in LXX: [[Sng.4.2; 6.5|Sng.4:2 6:5]], (6) (רַחְצָה), [[Sir.34.25|Sir.34:25]] * ;]
**a washing, bath**: τ. ὕδατος, [[Eph.5.26|Eph.5:26]] τ. παλιγγενεσίας, [[Tit.3.5|Tit.3:5]] (see AR, _Eph._, l.with).†
(AS)

G3028.def:
**λῆμψις** (Rec. λῆψις, so in cl.), -εως, ἡ
(λαμβάνω), [in LXX (λῆψ-): [[Pro.15.29|Pro.15:29]] λ. δώρων, [[Pro.15.27|Pro.15:27]] (מַתָּנָה); λ. καὶ δόσις, [[Sir.41.19; 42.7|Sir.41:19 42:7]] * ;]
**receiving**: δόσις καὶ λ., [[Php.4.15|Php.4:15]]†
(AS)

G3065.def:
**Λουκᾶς**, -ᾶ, ὁ
(prob. an abbreviation of Λουκανός; see Lft., Col., 240; _ICC_, Lk., xviii; Bl., § 29; accusative to Ramsay, _Exp._, Dec., 1912, pp. 502 ff., a by-form of Λούκιος, from Lat. Lucius),
**Luke**: Lk, tit., [[Col.4.14|Col.4:14]], [[2Ti.4.11|2Ti.4:11]], Phm 24.†
(AS)

G3059.def:
**λοιδορία**, -ας, ἡ
(λοιδορέω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב, מְרִיבָה ;]
**abuse, railing**: [[1Ti.5.14|1Ti.5:14]], [[1Pe.3.9|1Pe.3:9]].†
(AS)

G3044.def:
1. **Linos **, a mythical minstrel, son of Apollo and Urania (Calliope), teacher of Orpheus, (Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus), etc.
2. as appellative, **the song ** or **lay of Linos **, sung by a boy to the cithara while the vintagers are at work, Λίνον ὑπὸ καλὸν ἄειδεν sang **the ** lovely **lay of Linos ** in accompaniment, (Iliad by Homer):—;compare αἴλινος which is **a mournful song. ** (ML)

G3010.def:
**λειτουργικός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for עֲבֹדָה, שָׁרַת; ἔργα, Num_7:5; στολαί [[Exo.31.10; 39.32|Exo.31:10 39:32]]; σκευή, [[Num.4.12, 26|Num.4:12, 26]], [[2Ch.24.14|2Ch.24:14]] * ;]
**of or for service, ministering**: πνεύματα, [[Heb.1.14|Heb.1:14]]†
(AS)

G3024.def:
**λήθη**, -ης, ἡ
(λήθω = λανθάνω) [in LXX: [[Lev.5.15|Lev.5:15]] (מַעַל), [[Wis.16.11|Wis.16:11]], [[Sir.14.7|Sir.14:7]], al. ;]
**forgetfulness**: λ. λαβεῖν (on the phrase, see Mayor, in l): [[2Pe.1.9|2Pe.1:9]]†
(AS)

G3031.def:
**λιβανωτός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(λίβανος), [in LXX: [[1Ch.9.29|1Ch.9:29]], [[3Ma.5.2|3Ma.5:2]] * ;]
1. in cl. (and LXX), frankincense, the gum of the libanus.
2. = Late Gk., λιβανωτρίς, **a censer**: [[Rev.8.3|Rev.8:3]], 5 (the same form appears in Inscr.; MM, xvi).†
(AS)

G3045.def:
**λιπαρός**, -ά, -όν
(λίπος, fat), [in LXX: [[Jdg.3.29|Jdg.3:29]], [[Neh.9.35|Neh.9:35]], [[Isa.30.23|Is 30:23]] (שָׁמֵן)* ;]
**oily, fatty**; metaphorically, of living, **rich, dainty**: τὰ λ. καὶ τ. λαμπρά, [[Rev.18.14|Rev.18:14]]†
(AS)

G3098.def:
**Μαγώγ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מָגוֹג, [[Gen.10.2|Gen.10:2]], [[Exo.38.2|Exo.38:2]], al.),
**Magog, associated with Gog**: [[Rev.20.8|Rev.20:8]] (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)
